name: automem
description: Persistent memory across conversations. Remember preferences, decisions, and project context with AutoMem.

api_url.title: AutoMem API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your AutoMem REST API (for example https://your-app.railway.app or http://127.0.0.1:8001), not the remote MCP /mcp URL. AUTOMEM_API_URL in your environment or a project .env overrides the saved value. Leave empty to use your environment's setting, or http://127.0.0.1:8001.

api_key.title: AutoMem API key
api_key.description: API key if your AutoMem deployment requires auth. When an API URL is saved, the key is sent only to that URL. AUTOMEM_API_KEY in your environment or a project .env overrides the saved value. Leave empty for unauthenticated local instances.
